Advancing a Just Energy Transition in SIDS⚡️

The Antigua and Barbuda Agenda for SIDS outlined a clear priority for placing sustainable energy at the center of development - with many SIDS already leading the way towards 100% renewable energy in their power mix by 2030.  

This transition not only reaffirms their commitment to sustainability, but also presents a significant economic opportunity: while collectively adding 13 GW of new capacity, SIDS could save $3.3 billion annually (equivalent to 3.3% of GDP) by transitioning to 100% renewable energy.

For SIDS the transition to renewable energy serves as a powerful catalyst for integrated development solutions, enabling:
✅ Self-dependence
✅ Climate resilience
✅ Food security
✅ Economic diversification
✅ Sustainable development  

To unlock opportunities for SIDS🏝️ , policy and financial derisking; guarantee schemes; and private sector investments are enabling SIDS to transform development pathways and enhance their overall resilience to improve the quality of life for everyone.
